# Mainnet alpha-accounting discrepancy: adjacent non-epoch blocks

Generated: 2026-08-18T15:09:06.726Z

## Result

The assumption that the major discrepancy source is still accumulating every non-epoch block is **not supported**. Although 127 subnet(s) changed signed discrepancy, the maximum movement was only 0.000000003 α (3 rao). All non-zero signed changes were negative, so the transition slightly reduced every positive residual rather than creating it. This ubiquitous rao-scale rounding drift cannot explain residuals measured in hundreds or thousands of alpha.

The comparison is exact to one rao of alpha. A subnet is reported as changed when its raw signed discrepancy changes by any non-zero amount; no percentage tolerance was applied.

## Method

For each block and each active alpha subnet:

- Actual staked alpha = `sum(TotalHotkeyAlpha(hotkey, netuid))`.
- Pending alpha = `PendingServerEmission + PendingValidatorEmission + PendingRootAlphaDivs + PendingOwnerCut + PendingBasketDeposits`.
- Calculated staked alpha = `SubnetAlphaOut - AlphaBurned - pending alpha - SubnetProtocolAlpha`.
- Signed discrepancy Δ = `actual staked alpha - calculated staked alpha`.
- Change in discrepancy = `Δ(second block) - Δ(first block)`.

All components of each snapshot were read at the exact block hash shown above.
